{{Quote|We cannot get past their cannons, sir.''"<br />"Cannons?'' This will never do. We must pull back and set up our deflector shields.|A [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] and [[Whorm Loathsom/Legends|Whorm Loathsom]]|audio=ThisWillNeverDo-TCWf.flac|<ref name="TCW film" />}}
The '''AV-7 Antivehicle Cannon''', also known as the '''AV-7 Mobile Cannon''', the '''Republic Artillery Gun''', the '''heavy cannon''', or the '''Clone Artillery Cannon''', was a self-propelled artillery unit used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
[[File:Artillerylr.png|thumb|left|250px|Artillery Guns in action at the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]].]]
The vehicle could be operated by one [[Clone gunner/Legends|clone tank gunner]] in a seat on the side of the gun, and had a chamber for refilling plasma shells to the side of the lower chassis.

The vehicle would be moved with its built in [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] until it reached a suitable firing position and then entrench itself on the ground, using four metallic feet for support.

Its artillery shells created a fairly large blast radius, able to take out both vehicles and surrounding [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in a single shot.

==History==
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Give it everything you've got! Gunners&mdash;break out the AV-7!''<nowiki></nowiki>|[[Rex/Legends|Rex]]|<ref name="Burn the Behemoth!">{{TCWComicCite|6.17|Burn the Behemoth!}}</ref>}}
[[File:Clone_Gunner.png|thumb|right|220px|A single clone tank gunner operated the gun.]]
Republic Artillery Guns were used during the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]] where they countered the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy's]] [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AATs]] and titanic [[Octuptarra magna tri-droid/Legends|Tri-droids]]. The Separatists then erected a [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] which rendered the cannons ineffective. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] eventually destroyed the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]], disabling the shield and allowing four AV-7s to halt the enemy advance and help score the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] victory.<ref name="TCW film" />

These cannons were also used during the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]] when Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano were attempting to infiltrate a Separatist [[droid factory]]. Many of these cannons were destroyed by the Separatist experimental [[Separatist super-tank prototype/Legends|super tanks]].<ref name="Weapons Factory">{{TCW|Weapons Factory}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
After its appearance in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' animated film]], the AV-7 antivehicle cannon appeared in [[October]] [[2011]] as a miniature in the [[Clone Wars Tactics|''Clone Wars Tactics'' expansion]] of the ''[[Star Wars PocketModel TCG]]'' collection, which was later released on [[November 12]], 2008.<ref name="SWPM">{{PocketModel|set=Clone Wars Tactics|cardname=38th Armored Division Clone Artillery Cannon}}</ref>

In [[2011]], [[Hasbro]] produced a Clone Wars edition of the vehicle, the ''Republic AV-7 Mobile Cannon''. The action vehicle was built to accommodate the company's 3-3/4" action figure line of Star Wars figures. The vehicle featured a caterpillar-like tread assembly on the underside, in contrast to the in-universe units demonstrating motion via repulsorlifts.<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|pack=Republic AV-7 Mobile Cannon|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/story/vehicle/Republic_AV7_Mobile_Cannon_Found_139275.asp}}</ref>

In ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'', the AV-7 is the cannon option when playing on the Republic side in large battles, a counter to the CIS' [[J-1 semi-autonomous proton cannon|proton cannon]].
